final_state: All findings accepted and fixed. Both CRITICALs were about the producer's TESTING CLAIM, not the implementation.
cross_model_check: NOT verified-distinct — liter-llm gateway rejects authentication this session. Same model family as the producer. It nonetheless found two real CRITICALs the producer had missed.

findings.finding: The rewritten fetch health probe — the central code change of the Windows review — was never executed by any test. Making it throw left the entire suite green.
findings.verification: Confirmed by instrumenting the try block: 0 executions across the full suite. probeEndpoint was entered 25 times but always with no health_probe configured, returning early.
findings.disposition: FIXED. Exported probeEndpointForTest and added two tests driving the real path: a closed port (degrades, reason probe_failed) and a live server. Probe now executes 2 times. Mutations: making it throw → 1 failure; reverting to bash → 9 failures.
findings.note: The live-server test needed its server in a SEPARATE PROCESS: probeEndpoint is synchronous and spawnSync blocks the event loop, so an in-process server never accepts the connection and the probe times out against a server that is up. Cost a debugging cycle; the reason is recorded in the test.

findings.finding: Six tests guarded on `if (!existsSync(...)) return`, passing vacuously when the file under test was absent — including the only tests covering the spec requirement that the probe fix has a target.
findings.verification: Partially confirmed. Deleting the three files failed 2 tests, not 0 as the judge stated — but the six guarded tests did all pass vacuously, which is the substance.
findings.disposition: FIXED. Each silent return replaced with an assertion that the file is present, because a file the spec requires is an invariant rather than an optional fixture.

findings.finding: Four carried files build a self-invocation guard by string-concatenating a file:// URL, which never matches import.meta.url on Windows, so the guard silently never fires.
findings.disposition: FIXED in all four, plus a regression test covering all of scripts/. THIS IS THE SAME BUG change 1 fixed in hook-entry.mjs after its own diff review — the producer fixed it there and did not look for it elsewhere. That is the finding worth carrying to reflection.

findings.finding: The pathspec exclusion is legitimate scoping, not a loosened gate, but being whole-file it creates a blind spot inside the excluded file.
findings.judge_verification: The judge checked both directions: a TODO added to lib/refiner/state.mjs IS reported; a FIXME added inside the excluded file is NOT.
findings.disposition: ACCEPTED as disclosed debt. The constraint is severity:warning, the file is vendored, and the tradeoff was stated rather than hidden.

findings.finding: Two carried files exceed the 500-line limit (596, 525) and were not allowlisted.
findings.disposition: FIXED. Allowlisted as vendored, with the reason (splitting would fork the upstream file) and the follow-up recorded.

The QA gate works as advertised — the judge ran it end to end: absent manifest SKIPs exit 0, missing file FAILs naming it exit 2, zero-byte FAILs, valid manifest PASSes.

The unavailable-skill declarations satisfy the spec including the refine-mcp-ui and .mjs-only scenarios.
